references.quote_excerpt: For most biologics (exceptions: RTX and TCZ), consideration should be given to planning surgery when at least one dosing interval has elapsed for that specific drug; for higher risk procedures consider stopping 3–5 half-lives (if this is longer than one dosing interval) before surgery (grade 2B, SOA 97%).
references.quote_translation_excerpt: 大半の生物学的製剤 (RTX・TCZ を除く) では、 少なくとも 1 投与間隔が経過した時点で手術を計画することを考慮する。 高リスク手術では、 1 投与間隔より長ければ半減期の 3〜5 倍の休薬を考慮する (grade 2B, SOA 97%)
references.location_in_source: p.e29 Peri-operative care Recommendation (ii) + p.e30 Table 7 (Ustekinumab: Every 12 weeks, Week 13, half-life 21 days, five half-lives 105 days)

references.quote_excerpt: For patients with RA, AS, PsA, or JIA undergoing THA or TKA, withholding all biologics, including rituximab, prior to surgery and planning the surgery after the next dose is due is conditionally recommended.
references.quote_translation_excerpt: RA / AS / PsA / JIA 患者で待機的 THA/TKA を受ける場合、 リツキシマブを含む全ての生物学的製剤を術前に休薬し、 次回投与予定日の後に手術を計画することを条件付きで推奨
